description: This file defines a Java interface 'LogNode' which serves as a contract for logging components within a chain of log nodes. It specifies a method 'println' to output log data, supporting a chain of responsibility pattern for logging mechanisms.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system that can output to one or more targets, allowing for chaining and filtering of log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Instructs the first LogNode in the chain to print the provided log data, including level, tag, message, and an optional Throwable.
